# Files kept from the PCRE2 release archive: destination (under
# src/vendor/pcre2/) then source (in the archive), unchanged layout.
#
# The trim keeps what PCRE2's CMake build of the 8-bit library needs with
# the package's options (no pcre2grep, no tests, JIT on): CMakeLists.txt,
# cmake/, configure.ac (CMake reads the version from it), the .pc.in and
# pcre2-config.in templates, the library sources and templates in src/, and
# deps/sljit/sljit_src/ for the JIT. Left out: pcre2test, pcre2grep, the
# fuzzer, the demo, the test data, the docs and the autotools and other
# build systems.
#
# PCRE2 is the fallback for hs_capture(): configure prefers a system PCRE2
# (pkg-config libpcre2-8, pcre2-config, Rtools) and builds this copy with its
# symbols hidden only when there is none. See .agents/capture-groups.md.
